sloka: निहत्य तं वज्रिसुतोपमप्रभं कुमारमक्षं क्षतजोपमेक्षणम् ।तमेव वीरो ऽभिजगाम तोरणं कृतक्षणः काल इव प्रजाक्षये ।। ५.४७.३८।।
transliteration: nihatya taṁ vajrisutopamaprabhaṁ kumāramakṣaṁ kṣatajopamekṣaṇam ।tameva vīro 'bhijagāma toraṇaṁ kṛtakṣaṇaḥ kāla iva prajākṣaye ।। 5.47.38।।

translations.english: Hanuman, the hero with bloodshot eyes having slain Aksha, shone resplendent like the son of Indra (Jayanta), and reached the portal, and waited looking like the god of death determined to destroy all beings. इत्यार्षे वाल्मीकीये श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे सप्तचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortyseventh sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
